description: Complete Node.js/Express backend: server entry point, all middleware, all services, all controllers, all routes, cron jobs, Paystack integration, webhook handler, and health endpoint. Depends on FEAT-001 (schema, utils, env).
steps: Step 1 — Create server/server.js (ES module, the entry point). Import: express, cors, helmet, morgan, cookie-parser, dotenv/config, path, Sentry (conditional on SENTRY_DSN). Set up: app.use(helmet()), app.use(cors({origin: process.env.FRONTEND_URL, credentials:true})), app.use(express.json({verify: rawBodyBuffer for Paystack webhook})), app.use(cookieParser()), app.use(morgan('dev')). Mount routes: /api/auth, /api/contributions, /api/loans, /api/refunds, /api/admin, /api/paystack, /api/notifications. Add GET /health route that queries prisma.$queryRaw`SELECT 1` and returns {status:'ok',timestamp:new Date()}. Add global error handler middleware last. Import and start all three cron jobs. Call app.listen(PORT). Export app for potential testing.

Step 2 — Create server/src/middleware/auth.middleware.js: export async function authenticate(req, res, next). Extract JWT from req.cookies.token (httpOnly cookie). If missing, return 401. Verify with JWT_SECRET. Query DB for user by id from payload. If user not found or deletedAt set, return 401. Attach req.user = user (without passwordHash). Call next().

Step 3 — Create server/src/middleware/adminOnly.middleware.js: export function adminOnly(req, res, next). If req.user.role !== 'ADMIN', return 403 {error:'Forbidden'}. Call next(). Must be used after authenticate.

Step 4 — Create server/src/middleware/validate.middleware.js: export function validate(schema) returns middleware. Calls schema.parseAsync(req.body), on success sets req.validated = parsed data and calls next(). On ZodError returns 422 with {error:'Validation failed', details: error.flatten().fieldErrors}.

Step 5 — Create server/src/middleware/rateLimiter.middleware.js: export authLimiter = rateLimit({windowMs:15*60*1000, max:10, message:{error:'Too many requests, please try again later'}}). Export generalLimiter = rateLimit({windowMs:60*1000, max:60}). Uses express-rate-limit.

Step 6 — Create server/src/middleware/errorHandler.middleware.js: export function errorHandler(err, req, res, next). Log error with logger.error. If NODE_ENV=production return {error:'Internal server error'}. Else return {error: err.message, stack: err.stack}. Always 500 unless err.statusCode is set. Handle Prisma errors: P2002 (unique constraint) → 409, P2025 (not found) → 404.

Step 8 — Create server/src/services/ledger.service.js. Import PrismaClient. Export async function getCurrentBalance(ledger) — queries latest LedgerEntry for given LedgerBook, returns balanceAfterKobo or 0. Export async function appendLedgerEntry(prismaClient, {type, ledger, userId, loanId, amountKobo, reference}) — calculates new balance (getCurrentBalance + amountKobo for credits, subtract for debits based on type: LOAN_DISBURSEMENT and REFUND are debits from COMPANY_FUND; CONTRIBUTION is credit to SAVINGS; LOAN_REPAYMENT is credit to COMPANY_FUND; LOAN_FEE is credit to COMPANY_FUND; FUND_TOPUP is credit to COMPANY_FUND), creates LedgerEntry row with balanceAfterKobo, returns the new entry. Must be called inside a Prisma $transaction block — accepts the prisma transaction client as first arg.

Step 9 — Create server/src/services/email.service.js. Import nodemailer, create transporter using EMAIL_HOST/PORT/USER/PASS env vars. Export async functions:
  - sendWelcomeEmail(user) — subject 'Welcome to Oma Midas', body includes member name
  - sendApprovalEmail(user) — subject 'Your account has been approved'
  - sendRejectionEmail(user, reason) — subject 'Application update', includes reason
  - sendPasswordResetEmail(user, resetUrl) — subject 'Reset your password', includes link
  - sendContributionReminderEmail(user, month, year) — subject 'Monthly contribution reminder'
  - sendLoanInstallmentReminderEmail(user, installment) — subject 'Loan repayment reminder'
  - sendLoanApprovalEmail(user, loan) — subject 'Loan approved'
  - sendLoanRejectionEmail(user, loan) — subject 'Loan application update'
  - sendRefundApprovalEmail(user, refund) — subject 'Refund approved'
  Each function builds a simple but well-formatted HTML email using inline styles matching the brand colors (primary #4A1D4F, accent #C9A86A). Wrap all sends in try/catch and log failures without throwing (non-critical).

Step 10 — Create server/src/services/notification.service.js. Import PrismaClient. Export async function createNotification(prismaClient, {userId, title, message, type}) — inserts a Notification row. Export async function markNotificationsRead(userId, ids) — updates isRead=true for given ids belonging to userId. Export async function getUnreadCount(userId) — returns count of isRead=false for userId.

Step 11 — Create server/src/controllers/auth.controller.js. Import prisma, bcryptjs, jwt, uuid, crypto, ledger service, email service, notification service, kobo utils, logger. Export async functions:
  - register(req, res, next): validate body (fullName, email, phone, password, bankName, accountNumber, accountName). Check email unique. Hash password with bcrypt(12). Create user with status=PENDING. Return 201 {message:'Registration submitted, awaiting approval'}.
  - login(req, res, next): find user by email. If not found or password wrong → 401. If status=PENDING → 403 {error:'Account pending approval', status:'PENDING'}. If status=REJECTED → 403 {error:'Application rejected', reason: user.rejectionReason, status:'REJECTED'}. If status=INACTIVE → 403. Sign JWT {id, role, status} with JWT_SECRET. Set httpOnly cookie 'token' (secure: NODE_ENV=production, sameSite:'strict', maxAge:7d). Return {user: {id, fullName, email, role, status}}.
  - logout(req, res): clearCookie('token'). Return {message:'Logged out'}.
  - me(req, res): return req.user fields (no passwordHash).
  - forgotPassword(req, res, next): find user by email. Generate resetToken=uuid(), hash it, store as passwordResetToken + passwordResetExpires (1 hour) on user record (add these fields to schema: passwordResetToken String?, passwordResetExpires DateTime?). Send reset email with link FRONTEND_URL/reset-password?token=rawToken. Always return same message whether user exists or not.
  - resetPassword(req, res, next): hash incoming token, find user where passwordResetToken=hash AND passwordResetExpires > now. If not found → 400. Hash new password, update user, clear reset fields. Return {message:'Password updated'}.

Step 12 — Add passwordResetToken String? and passwordResetExpires DateTime? fields to the User model in schema.prisma (update from Step 3 of FEAT-001). Run `npx prisma migrate dev --name add-reset-token` from server/ after updating schema.

Step 13 — Create server/src/routes/auth.routes.js. Import Router from express, auth controller, rateLimiter, validate middleware, zod schemas. Define Zod schemas inline: registerSchema (z.object with fullName min 2, email, phone min 10, password min 8, bankName, accountNumber, accountName). loginSchema (email, password). forgotSchema (email). resetSchema (token string, password min 8). Routes: POST /register (authLimiter, validate(registerSchema), register), POST /login (authLimiter, validate(loginSchema), login), POST /logout (authenticate, logout), GET /me (authenticate, me), POST /forgot-password (authLimiter, validate(forgotSchema), forgotPassword), POST /reset-password (authLimiter, validate(resetSchema), resetPassword).

Step 14 — Create server/src/controllers/contributions.controller.js. Export async functions:
  - getMyContributions(req, res): find all contributions for req.user.id in current active cycle, return array with month/year/status/amountKobo/paidAt.
  - getContributionStatus(req, res): return this month's contribution status for current user.
  - initializePayment(req, res): find active cycle. Check if this month's contribution already PAID → 400. Create pending Contribution record (status=PENDING) or find existing. Call paystack.initializeTransaction with amount=monthlyAmountKobo (from settings or fixed 500000 kobo = ₦5000), email=user.email, reference=uuid(), metadata={userId, cycleId, month, year, type:'CONTRIBUTION'}. Return {authorization_url}.
  - getConsistentStreak(req, res): count consecutive paid months from most recent going backwards for current user in current cycle.

Step 15 — Create server/src/routes/contributions.routes.js. Routes: GET / (authenticate, getMyContributions), GET /status (authenticate, getContributionStatus), POST /initialize-payment (authenticate, initializePayment), GET /streak (authenticate, getConsistentStreak).

Step 16 — Create server/src/controllers/loans.controller.js. Export async functions:
  - checkEligibility(req, res): check all conditions: user.status=ACTIVE, no existing loan with status not in [REJECTED,COMPLETED], check consecutive paid months >= min_consecutive_months (skip for EXISTING members if within first 3 months of cycle), company fund balance sufficient. Return {eligible: bool, reasons:[]}.
  - requestLoan(req, res): validate body {requestedAmountKobo, repaymentMonths, installmentSchedule:[{dueDate, amountKobo}]}. Re-run eligibility checks. Calculate breakdown using calculateLoanBreakdown. Validate: installmentSchedule amounts sum to totalRepayableKobo, all dates before cycle end (Sep 30), repaymentMonths matches schedule length. Validate max loan = 3x total savings in cycle. Create Loan record (status=PENDING) + LoanInstallment records in a $transaction. Return loan with installments.
  - getMyLoans(req, res): return all loans for user with installments.
  - getMyCurrentLoan(req, res): return most recent active loan.
  - initializeLoanRepayment(req, res): validate body {installmentId}. Find installment belonging to user's loan. Check not already PAID. Call paystack.initializeTransaction with amount=installment.amountKobo, reference=uuid(), metadata={installmentId, loanId, userId, type:'LOAN_REPAYMENT'}. Return {authorization_url}.

Step 17 — Create server/src/routes/loans.routes.js. Routes: GET /eligibility (authenticate, checkEligibility), POST / (authenticate, requestLoan), GET / (authenticate, getMyLoans), GET /current (authenticate, getMyCurrentLoan), POST /repayment/initialize (authenticate, initializeLoanRepayment).

Step 18 — Create server/src/controllers/refunds.controller.js. Export async functions:
  - requestRefund(req, res): check user has no outstanding loan (any loan with status DISBURSED or REPAYING) → 400 if yes. Find active cycle, calculate total savings (sum of PAID contributions in cycle). If 0 → 400. Check no existing pending refund. Create Refund record status=PENDING. Return refund.
  - getMyRefunds(req, res): return all refunds for user.
Step 19 — Create server/src/routes/refunds.routes.js. Routes: POST / (authenticate, requestRefund), GET / (authenticate, getMyRefunds).
Step 20 — Create server/src/controllers/notifications.controller.js. Export: getNotifications(req,res) paginated list for user, markRead(req,res) marks array of ids read, getUnreadCount(req,res).
Step 21 — Create server/src/routes/notifications.routes.js. Routes: GET / (authenticate, getNotifications), PUT /read (authenticate, markRead), GET /unread-count (authenticate, getUnreadCount).

Step 22 — Create server/src/controllers/paystack.controller.js. Export:
  - webhook(req, res): verify x-paystack-signature header (HMAC-SHA512 of raw body using PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY). If invalid → 401. Parse event. Handle these events:
    * charge.success: if metadata.type='CONTRIBUTION' → find contribution by paystackRef, if still PENDING: update to PAID, call appendLedgerEntry for SAVINGS ledger (credit), call createNotification for user. If metadata.type='LOAN_REPAYMENT' → find installment, update to PAID, check if all installments paid → update loan status to COMPLETED, else REPAYING, appendLedgerEntry LOAN_REPAYMENT to COMPANY_FUND.
    * transfer.success: if associated with a Loan → update loan status to DISBURSED, appendLedgerEntry LOAN_DISBURSEMENT (debit from COMPANY_FUND) and LOAN_FEE (credit). If associated with a Refund → update status to TRANSFERRED, appendLedgerEntry REFUND (debit).
    * transfer.failed / transfer.reversed: update loan/refund status to FAILED. Create failure notification.
    All DB operations in $transaction. Return 200 immediately.
  - resolveAccount(req,res): call paystack.resolveAccountNumber, return account_name.
  - listBanks(req,res): call paystack.listBanks, return banks array.

Step 23 — Create server/src/routes/paystack.routes.js. Routes: POST /webhook (no auth, raw body needed — use express.raw middleware on this route), GET /resolve-account (authenticate, resolveAccount), GET /banks (listBanks — public).

Step 24 — Create server/src/controllers/admin.controller.js. All routes use authenticate + adminOnly. Export:
  - getDashboardStats(req,res): count users by status, sum contributions, get company fund balance, sum active loans, sum repayments. Call paystack.getBalance(). Return all stats.
  - getPendingMembers(req,res): list users with status=PENDING, paginated.
  - approveMember(req,res): update user status=ACTIVE, memberType from body (NEW|EXISTING). Send approval email. Create welcome notification. Log audit.
  - rejectMember(req,res): update status=REJECTED, set rejectionReason. Send rejection email. Log audit.
  - getAllMembers(req,res): search by name/email, filter by status, paginated.
  - getMemberDetail(req,res): full member profile with contributions, loans, refunds.
  - deactivateMember(req,res): soft delete (set deletedAt, status=INACTIVE). Log audit.
  - getLoanRequests(req,res): list loans with status filter, include user savings and streak.
  - approveLoan(req,res): check company fund has enough. Create transfer recipient if user has no paystackRecipientCode. Call paystack.initiateTransfer for disbursedAmountKobo. Update loan: status=APPROVED, paystackTransferCode. In $transaction: record LOAN_FEE ledger entry immediately (30% stays in fund). Send approval email + notification. Log audit.
  - rejectLoan(req,res): update status=REJECTED with reason. Send rejection email + notification. Log audit.
  - getRefundRequests(req,res): list refunds with status filter.
  - approveRefund(req,res): check no outstanding loans. Get user's savings total. Call initiateTransfer for amountKobo. Update status=APPROVED. Log audit.
  - rejectRefund(req,res): update status=REJECTED with reason. Log audit.
  - getCompanyFundBalance(req,res): return current COMPANY_FUND ledger balance + Paystack balance.
  - recordFundTopup(req,res): validate body {amountKobo, reference, note}. appendLedgerEntry FUND_TOPUP. Log audit.
  - getAllTransactions(req,res): query LedgerEntry with date/type filters, paginated, CSV export if ?format=csv.
  - getAuditLogs(req,res): paginated audit log with admin name.
  - getSettings(req,res): return all settings key/value pairs.
  - updateSetting(req,res): upsert setting by key. For terms_and_conditions allow HTML. Log audit.
  - startNewCycle(req,res): set current cycle isActive=false, create new cycle startDate=Oct 1 of next year, isActive=true. Identify ACTIVE members → keep as EXISTING type for new cycle. Log audit.
  Helper: async function logAudit(adminId, action, targetType, targetId, metadata) creates AuditLog row.

Step 25 — Create server/src/routes/admin.routes.js. Mount all admin controller endpoints with authenticate + adminOnly on every route. Routes: GET /dashboard, GET /members/pending, PUT /members/:id/approve, PUT /members/:id/reject, GET /members, GET /members/:id, DELETE /members/:id (deactivate), GET /loans, PUT /loans/:id/approve, PUT /loans/:id/reject, GET /refunds, PUT /refunds/:id/approve, PUT /refunds/:id/reject, GET /company-fund, POST /company-fund/topup, GET /transactions, GET /audit-logs, GET /settings, PUT /settings/:key, POST /cycles/new.

Step 26 — Create server/src/jobs/reconciliation.job.js. Import node-cron, prisma, paystack service, ledger service, logger. Export function startReconciliationJob(). Schedule: '0 * * * *' (every hour). Also call the reconcile function immediately on startup. The reconcile() async function:
  (a) Find all Contributions with status=PENDING and paystackRef not null, call verifyTransaction for each. If status=success and not already processed → update to PAID + ledger entry. Skip if already PAID (idempotent).
  (b) Find all Loans with status=APPROVED and paystackTransferCode not null, call fetchTransfer. If status=success → DISBURSED + ledger entries. If failed → FAILED.
  (c) Find all Refunds with status=APPROVED and paystackTransferCode not null, call fetchTransfer. If success → TRANSFERRED + ledger. If failed → FAILED.
  (d) Find all LoanInstallments with status=PENDING and paystackRef not null, call verifyTransaction. Process similar to contributions.
  Wrap each item in try/catch so one failure doesn't stop others. Log results.

Step 27 — Create server/src/jobs/reminder.job.js. Import node-cron, prisma, email service, notification service. Export function startReminderJob(). Schedule: '0 9 * * *' (daily at 9am). The remind() async function:
  (a) Find active cycle. For each ACTIVE member, check if this month's contribution is missing or PENDING. If so, check Notification table: if no notification with type='CONTRIBUTION_REMINDER' was created today for this user → createNotification + sendContributionReminderEmail.
  (b) Find all LoanInstallments with status PENDING or OVERDUE, dueDate <= today + 3 days. For each, check no reminder sent today → createNotification + sendLoanInstallmentReminderEmail.
  (c) Find all LoanInstallments with status PENDING and dueDate < today → update status to OVERDUE.
  Log count of reminders sent.

Step 28 — Create server/src/jobs/keepalive.job.js. Import node-cron, prisma, logger. Export function startKeepaliveJob(). Schedule: '0 3 * * *' (daily at 3am). Runs prisma.$queryRaw`SELECT 1` and logs 'DB keepalive ping successful'.

Step 29 — Create server/src/utils/cycleHelpers.js. Export async function getActiveCycle(prisma) — finds first cycle where isActive=true, throws if not found. Export async function getMemberSavingsInCycle(prisma, userId, cycleId) — sums amountKobo of PAID contributions for that user+cycle. Export async function getConsecutivePaidMonths(prisma, userId, cycleId) — starting from most recent month, counts consecutive PAID months going backwards.

Step 30 — Update server/server.js to also import and call startReconciliationJob(), startReminderJob(), startKeepaliveJob() after DB connection is confirmed. Import prisma and do a $queryRaw SELECT 1 at startup; log 'Database connected' or exit process on failure.
acceptance_criteria: Server starts with `npm run dev` from server/ with zero errors and logs 'Server running on port 5000'
POST /api/auth/register creates a PENDING user in DB
POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials returns cookie + user object
GET /api/admin/dashboard with valid admin JWT cookie returns stats object
All cron jobs initialize without throwing on startup
verification: From server/: `npm install && npx prisma generate && npx prisma migrate dev --name init && node src/prisma/seed.js` — all exit 0
From server/: `npm run dev` — server starts, logs 'Server running on port 5000', no uncaught errors
findings: Schema updated: added rejectionReason String? to User model, and FAILED to LoanStatus enum (both needed by admin controller and webhook handler). passwordResetToken/passwordResetExpires were already present from FEAT-001. Server starts cleanly with a real DB — exits only on placeholder DATABASE_URL in .env. All 30 steps implemented: 5 middleware, 4 services, 7 controllers, 7 routes, 3 cron jobs, server.js entry point.
